name: Grave Chisel
desc: Replace one symbol on one reel with a symbol of your choice.

name: Rite of Unmaking
desc: Remove one Skull from a reel; the slot becomes Blank.

name: Oath of the Blade
desc: Level up a symbol type for the rest of the run: all Swords +1 damage (or the matching stat for another symbol).

name: Second Pull
desc: Reroll the current reels once for free, mid-fight.
